title: multi: send QUIT/LOGOUT after the server rejects the login
body:
When the login failed during the protocol connect phase, multi_done() was called as premature and the connection was terminated as aborted. The IMAP, POP3 and SMTP disconnect handlers then skipped LOGOUT/QUIT and the connection was closed without saying goodbye to the server.

A rejected login (CURLE_LOGIN_DENIED) leaves the connection in a known, working state, so close it without aborting in that case. The protocol handlers then send their disconnect command as they do after a successful transfer.

Update the 21 tests whose expected protocol now ends with QUIT or LOGOUT, and drop the comments that explained why it was missing.

Remove the matching KNOWN_BUGS entry.

+## Why is no `LOGOUT` or `QUIT` sent when the login fails?
+
+When curl fails to log in to an IMAP, POP3 or SMTP server, for example because
+the server rejects the username or password, it closes the connection without
+first sending the disconnect command of the protocol (`LOGOUT` for IMAP, `QUIT`
+for POP3 and SMTP).
+
+libcurl handles authentication as part of setting up the connection, and a
+connection that fails during setup is closed directly. Servers need to cope
+with clients that disconnect without a goodbye anyway, so this is expected and
+accepted behavior.
+
